# Qodo

Skills that teach agents to work with Qodo. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [qodo-ai/qodo-skills](https://github.com/qodo-ai/qodo-skills), at commit `b8c2185`.

Qodo setup, code intelligence, and review workflows.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Qodo**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Qodo**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install qodo@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

5 skills: `qodo-codebase-wisdom`, `qodo-review`, `qodo-review-notes`, `qodo-review-resolver`, `qodo-setup`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/qodo-ai/qodo-skills
